d:
Mokama – once known as the Mini Kolkata of Bihar, famous for its factories, industries, and hardworking people. But today, it is remembered more for crime than development.
In this ground report, Khabar Gaon team — Akash and Jerry — travel 90 km from Patna to explore the truth behind Mokama’s forgotten factories, rising anger, and political silence.
What happened to the Bata Factory, McDowell liquor plant & India Wagon Engineering Company?
Why did Nitish Kumar’s liquor ban turn into a crisis for local workers?
Why are these shut factories never an election issue?
